Running `npm run test` had 3 specific failures originally (task-312):
1. **`test/cssBaseline.test.cjs:57`**:
   - Error: `!important total is 1806, baseline ceiling is 1631`.
   - Cause: When styling `surfaces.css` and `screens.css`, redundant `!important` declarations were added to dozens of CSS rules (padding, border, font, etc.). In addition, an accidental duplication occurred in `surfaces.css`.
   - Fix: Keep `!important` count `<= 1631`. Do NOT use `!important` for general property updates. `#root#root .shell` already has high specificity (0,2,1).
2. **`test/groundstationRedesign.test.cjs:336`**:
   - Error: `.mc-ref-manifest is not raised with the shared elevation token`.
   - Cause: The test explicitly requires:
     - In `tokens-bridge.css`:
       - `assert.match(tokens, /--mc-edge: inset 0 1px 0 rgba\(255, 255, 255, \.045\);/);`
       - `assert.match(tokens, /--mc-raise-1:[^;]*var\(--mc-edge\);/);`
       - `assert.match(tokens, /--mc-raise-2:[^;]*var\(--mc-edge\);/);`
       - `assert.match(tokens, /--mc-hairline: rgba\(233, 238, 247, \.055\);/);`
     - In `screens.css`:
       - For `.mc-ref-manifest`, `.mc-gs-inspector`, and `.mc-gs-attention`:
         `box-shadow: var(--mc-raise-2)` (with or without `!important`).
       - For `.mc-ref-manifest-row`:
         `border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mc-hairline) !important;`
3. **`test/groundstationRenderer.test.cjs:261`**:
   - Error: `The input did not match the regular expression /--mc-text-dim:\s*#8e94a2/`.
   - Cause: `tokens-bridge.css` had changed `--mc-text-dim` from `#8e94a2` to `#95a2b1`.
   - Fix: Set `--mc-text-dim: #8e94a2;` in `tokens-bridge.css`.
